title: Density one of H^n on a set covered by closed Lipschitz graphs of arbitrarily small slope
statement: Let A ⊆ ℝ^N with H^n(A) < ∞ and A H^n-null-measurable, and suppose that for every L ∈ (0,1] there is a countable set C_L ⊆ G(N,n) × 2^{ℝ^N} such that every (P, Γ) ∈ C_L has Γ closed and an L-graph over P (|q_P(y − z)| ≤ L|p_P(y − z)| on Γ), and A ⊆ ⋃_{(P,Γ) ∈ C_L} Γ. Let λ := H^n⌞A. Then for λ-a.e. x, λ(B_r(x))/(ω_n r^n) → 1 as r ↓ 0, i.e. HasDensity n λ x 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (A : Set (Euclidean N)), μHE[n] A ≠ ∞ → NullMeasurableSet A μHE[n] → (∀ L : ℝ, 0 < L → L ≤ 1 → ∃ C : Set (Grassmannian N n × Set (Euclidean N)), C.Countable ∧ (∀ c ∈ C, IsClosed c.2 ∧ ∀ y ∈ c.2, ∀ z ∈ c.2, ‖(y - z) - Grassmannian.project c.1 (y - z)‖ ≤ L * ‖Grassmannian.project c.1 (y - z)‖) ∧ A ⊆ ⋃ c ∈ C, c.2) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict A, HasDensity n ((μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict A) x 1
